title: Ancient Library Dungeon
description: A detailed isometric cutaway view of a vast multi-level fantasy library and dungeon complex. Stone architecture with arched hallways, spiral staircases, bookshelves, glowing magical circles, torches, and scattered skeletal remains are visible across the interconnected chambers.
prompt: Isometric cutaway view of a massive ancient fantasy library dungeon, multiple levels connected by spiral stairs and bridges, stone walls with arched doorways, filled bookshelves, glowing magical circles on the floor, scattered skeletons, lit torches, atmospheric lighting, detailed stone textures, teal and purple color palette, high fantasy illustration style
